PROP-01b-partial3-inv-018.text: Reserves must increase proportionally: reservesNew = reserves + interestAccumulated * reserveFactor.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-018.assertion: forall accrueInterest: totalReserves_post == totalReserves_pre + interestAccumulated * reserveFactor

locations.note: Updates cash_reserve via: self.cash_reserve = self.cash_reserve.add(reserve_factor.mul(interest_accumulated)). Note: reserve_factor here is passed as asset.repay_fee_rate() which doubles as the reserve factor
Passes asset.repay_fee_rate() as the reserve_factor arg to reserve.accrue_interest
